scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Symplectic Ball Packings in Higher Dimensions” (preprints/Symplectic-Ball-Packings-in-Higher-Dimensions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 343 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 54a390c7a58b2f00), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 3 and k ≥ 1 be integers. For positive real numbers R, R1, . . . , Rk, there exists a symplectic embedding k ⨆︂ i=1 B2n (Ri) ↪→ int B2n (R) if and only if k ∑︂ i=1 Rn i < Rn , Ri + Rj < R (1 ≤ i < j ≤ k). (1.1)
